page.name: MAIN
page.editor: EasyEDA Pro V4.1.78, Edge maximized on a 1280x2568 display, canvas crop (265,215) 660x2030

question: W1 (210,795) and W2 (390,795): what does the blue net name actually cover - pin number, pin name, pin line or wire?

method.declareThenCapture: each rect was printed before the zoom. W1: x 200-280 / y 672-918, centred at 240 on the label ink (229.8-248.9) so that the pin name PA10 (252-268) is in the same frame. W2: two frames - x 355-435 (centre 395) carries everything on the row (flag name, PB10, number 21, label ink), and x 379-459 (centre 419.35) is centred exactly on the wire-label ink as the brief asks.
method.capture: eda.dmt_EditorControl.zoomToRegion(left,right,top,bottom) at 80x246 units, then a 1:1 screen capture of the 660x2030 canvas; 660/80 = 8.25 px/unit
method.readback: after capture the frame is checked against known objects: PA10 appears at x 252-268 (inside 200-280), PB10 at 369-388 and pin number 21 at 395-402 (inside 355-435); both anchors, (210,795) -> px 82.5 and (390,795) -> px 288.8, are inside their frames
method.inkCounting: per label: find the blue runs row by row, take each run's bbox, then count black / green / red pixels *inside* that bbox. That answers 'what is under the text' without relying on page coordinates
method.readOnly: only eda.dmt_EditorControl.zoomToRegion / zoomToAllPrimitives plus read calls; no save, delete, create, modify or clear

frames.readback: the label ink lands at page x 229.8-248.9 (px 246-403), the symbols left edge at x 249, PA10 at 252-268 (px 429-561), the pin number 31 inside the label band
the flag name ink at page x 369.2-388.3, PB10 at 370-388, pin number 21 at 395-402, the wire label ink at 409.8-428.9 (px 452-610) - all inside 355-435
frames.note: context frame: shifted 24 units left of the ink centre so that PB10 (369-388) and the pin number 21 (395-402) are both inside it; the label-centred version is r2t1-w2-centered.png
centred on the label ink at 419.35, as the brief asks; the grey junction dot sits inside the text run and the green wire runs under it, with no black glyph anywhere in the ink box

frames.role: camera returned to the whole-page fit with zoomToAllPrimitives() after the two frames

w1.blackGlyphs: the digits 31, interleaved with the blue letters (3 between C and U, 1 after U): in the 3x crop the shapes are unambiguously digits, not letters
w1.objectIdentity: u1-e44 'Pin Number' = 31 (its 'Pin Name' is PA10 at 233,790.1). PA10's glyphs render at x 252-268, outside the label ink, and are fully readable in this frame
w1.alsoUnderIt: the green line is this label's own MCU-34 wire (210,795)-(250,795), which runs along the text baseline; it is not a foreign wire

w2.blackGlyphs: none - no black glyph lies under this label at all

nearestBlack.pinNumber21: x 395-402, 8 units to the left, untouched
nearestBlack.pinNamePB10: x 369-388, 22 units to the left, untouched by this label

w2.alsoUnderIt: a green wire grazes the bottom of the text box: 485 green pixels over 2 rows, about 0.5 unit, so the stroke never crosses glyph ink

adjacentFlagName.objectIdentity: PB10 (u1-e108 'Pin Name' PB10 at 367,790.1); the blue letters sit on the black letters, which is where the 'MCE8/28' fused look comes from
adjacentFlagName.note: this is the net flag's own name, not the wire label attr102 the r8t1 rule flagged

reconciliation.t1 (pin name): reads the flag name column at x 369-388, which does sit on PB10
reconciliation.t4 (nearest text is the pin number): reads attr102 at 409-429 and finds the number 21 as the nearest text - correct: 21 is 8 units away and not covered
reconciliation.t5 (black glyphs are pin numbers): correct at W1, where the digits are 31/32; the specific digits 18/19/20 quoted in t5 come from the PB0-PB2 rows in the earlier frame, not from W1
reconciliation.why they looked contradictory: three different objects are 20 units apart on the same row: the flag name (350) over PB10, the pin number 21 (395-402), and the wire label (409-429) over a wire. The r8t1 rule only ever flagged the wire label, so the other two were never in the candidate list

correctionsApplied.what: A box: 'not reproduced' -> 'the frame covers 380-460, the A band is 560-620, so it is a framing gap'; restored.png: pxPerUnit kept but paired with renderSize 660x1370 and a note that the 2030-tall crop is mostly empty canvas; w1w2 block marked superseded
文字-文字 row, W1/W2 table, the two 'why reclassified' notes and the host-adjudication block now say W1 presses pin number 31, the flag name presses PB10, attr102 only grazes a wire; 导线穿字/穿符号 still 判不了
foreignLabelCandidates[0..1] object text, ink bboxes, hostAdjudication.correctedBy, conclusion; thresholds and all numbers untouched

invariantsUntouched.thresholds: d, t, TEXT_RADIUS and d<=12 keep their values; no band was widened or narrowed
invariantsUntouched.geometry: endpoint blocks 4/3 and geometric 1/1 are untouched

limits: the +19.4 render offset is measured, not documented: label and pin-number attributes draw about 19 units to the right of their stored X, pin names about 2 units. The verdicts rest on the ink-inside-bbox counts, so they do not depend on the offset
a 0.5-unit graze is below the resolution of any bbox rule; calling attr102 'wire graze' rather than 'wire through text' is a judgement about ink, stated as such
this file records what the pixels show; it does not decide whether a graze should count as 导线穿字 - that stays 判不了
overall: W1 = 压引脚编号 (31, not PA10); W2 = 压导线 (no text under it, a wire and a junction dot are); the pin-name impression comes from the adjacent net-flag name over PB10. Wire-through-text remains 判不了.
